title: SecurePrompt — Token & Cost
description: Daily token consumption and cost by workspace and model.

targets.rawSql: SELECT usage_date, model, sum(total_cost_usd) AS cost_usd FROM secureprompt_marts.default.mart_usage_daily GROUP BY usage_date, model ORDER BY usage_date ASC

SELECT usage_date, model, sum(total_input_tokens) AS input_tokens, sum(total_output_tokens) AS output_tokens FROM secureprompt_marts.default.mart_usage_daily GROUP BY usage_date, model ORDER BY usage_date ASC
SELECT model, usage_date, daily_cost_usd, rolling_7d_cost_usd, rolling_30d_cost_usd FROM secureprompt_marts.default.mart_cost_by_model ORDER BY usage_date DESC LIMIT 100
